raise_StateDictError_if_not_empty: call StateDictError.raise_if_not_empty to validate a state_dict and raise if it contains unexpected keys
raise_OperationalError_from_OSError: call raise_operational_system_error to wrap an OSError into an OperationalError with the original cause
raise_InternalError: raise InternalError to signal an unexpected internal condition in fairseq2 code
raise_InvalidOperationError: raise InvalidOperationError to signal that an operation was called in an invalid context
raise_NotSupportedError: raise NotSupportedError to signal that a requested feature or operation is not supported
